solver.other_solver_parameters: All omitted exactly as in released SCOT.find_correspondences; installed POT defaults apply.
solver.initialization: Uniform product a outer b, POT default G0=None; no randomization or self-tuning.

gate.interpretation: Prospective reference reproduction check, not a certified optimum or a stochastic production loss gate. The published POT loss and reproduced author log both use the prescribed-marginal expression; they are compared with an explicit 0.005 tolerance. Actual-marginal raw and repaired full losses are reported separately; the repaired loss must independently be at most 0.025.

interpretation: Original SCOT/POT settings, installed library defaults recorded; raw and output-only repaired GW costs are independently evaluated in float64. No tightened alternate solve or optimizer selection.
